title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
keyIdea: A merge takes the max of each position, so values only increase. Any triplet with a value above the target can never be used. Merge all the others: the result is the target exactly if every target value appears in at least one of them.

approaches.name: Greedy: keep the safe triplets
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Skip triplets with any value > target; for the rest mark found[k] when t[k] == target[k]; answer found[0] && found[1] && found[2].

quiz.q: Why can a triplet with t[0] > target[0] never be used?
options: Merging takes the max, so position 0 would stay above the target forever
It is too big to store

quiz.q: Why is merging every safe triplet harmless?
options: They never push any value above the target, and merges never decrease values
Because there are only three values
